quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditure payments were $188.1 million in fiscal 2025 ($130.9 million in 2024, $131.3 million in 2023), including investments to replace end-of-life mask-making equipment; fiscal 2026 capex is targeted at high-end and mainstream point tools. As of October 31, 2025 Photronics had outstanding capital commitments of approximately $126.4 million plus approximately $13.0 million of accrued liabilities for capital equipment purchases, and expects to fund $120.0 million of its $139.4 million committed and recognized capex obligations over the next twelve months.
quarterly_data.figure: capex payments $188.1 million (fiscal 2025) vs $130.9 million (2024); capital commitments ~$126.4 million (as of Oct 31, 2025); $120.0 million of $139.4 million to be funded over the next twelve months
